title: Wealth Management Associate – Operations & Analytics
description:
***Welfin*** is looking for a young and detail\-oriented \*Wealth Management Associate – Operations \& Analytics\* to support our Wealth Management team in client onboarding, mutual fund transaction execution, portfolio operations and basic portfolio analysis.

The role will be \*primarily operations and execution oriented\*, with exposure to portfolio analytics and wealth management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Investment Operations \& Execution – Primary Responsibility:**

\* Handle end\-to\-end client onboarding including KYC, CAN, FATCA and NACH mandates.

\* Process mutual fund transactions including purchases, redemptions, switches, SIP/STP/SWP and related service requests.

\* Coordinate with AMCs, CAMS, KFintech and other service providers.

\* Track pending transactions and ensure timely resolution.

\* Maintain accurate client and transaction records.

\* Perform transaction and portfolio reconciliation.

**Portfolio Analytics – Secondary Responsibility:**

\* Assist in preparation of client portfolio reports.

\* Track basic portfolio performance including \*XIRR, CAGR and absolute returns\*.

\* Review asset allocation and identify basic concentration/duplication issues.

\* Assist the Wealth Manager in preparing portfolio review reports.

\* Monitor deviations from recommended asset allocation and flag them to the senior team.

**MIS \& Reporting:**

\* Maintain daily/weekly operational MIS.

\* Update CRM and portfolio management systems.

\* Prepare transaction and client\-level reports.

\* Support digitisation and automation of operational processes.

***Who We Are Looking For\-\-\-\-***

\* Graduate in \*\*B.Com/BBA/Finance/Economics\*\* or related discipline.

\* 0–2 years of experience in mutual fund, wealth management, banking, broking or financial\-services operations.

\* Freshers with strong financial knowledge may also apply.

\* Good knowledge of \*MS Excel/Google Sheets\*.

\* Basic understanding of Mutual Funds and investment products.

\* Good numerical and analytical ability.

\* Strong attention to detail.

\* Good communication and follow\-up skills.

\* Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders.

***Preferred\-\-\-\-***

\* \*NISM Series V\-A\* certification or willingness to obtain it.

\* Exposure to CAMS/KFintech/BSE Star MF.

\* Basic understanding of XIRR and CAGR.

\* Internship or prior experience in wealth management/MF operations.

**What the candidate will learn\-\-\-**

The candidate will get practical exposure to:

\*Client Onboarding → KYC → MF Transaction Execution → RTA Coordination → Reconciliation → Portfolio Reporting → Portfolio Analytics\*

This makes the role particularly suitable for someone who wants to build a career in \*Wealth Management / Investment Operations / Portfolio Management\*.

***Contact Number: 7439366153***

Pay: ₹17,000\.55 \- ₹22,000\.52 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
